text: {"lessons":["I should base sell decisions on whether a stock’s outlook has changed, not simply on being below my average cost; several of my sales realized losses without showing that the replacements were better.","I should set a clear reason and position-size limit before adding to a holding, rather than buying more just because I have cash or recently bought it.","A few months of account changes cannot tell me whether I’m beating the market; I should review returns over longer periods against a suitable benchmark and keep a consistent process."]}
